standing.title: Your standing
standing.clean: Clean record — no active strikes. Keep being you.
standing.caption: Strikes expire 90 days after they're issued. A human reviews every removal, and you can always appeal.
standing.removedBody: A member of our team — a human, not a bot — reviewed your account and confirmed a third violation. Your matches see only this: “This account is no longer on Resonance.” Nothing more is said about you, to anyone.

scamBanner.title: Heads up from Scam Shield
scamBanner.body: This conversation is showing a pattern common in romance scams. Never send crypto or money to someone you haven't met in person — no matter how real it feels.
scamBanner.note: The other person hasn't been accused of anything and can't see this notice.

cryptoHint.body: Totally fine to talk crypto here — learning is welcome. One tip that protects everyone: never send money or crypto to someone you haven't met in person.

removed.peer: This account is no longer on Resonance.

appeal.title: Appeal this decision
appeal.body: If you believe this is wrong, you can appeal. A different member of our team will review everything fresh — we reply within 72 hours and decide within 7 days. If your appeal succeeds, everything is restored exactly as it was.
appeal.placeholder: Tell us, in your own words, why you think this decision is wrong. A human reads every word.
appeal.thanks: We've got it — a human is on your case. Your appeal is in the queue; whatever the outcome, you'll hear it from a person, in plain words.
appeal.error: Couldn't send your appeal — check your connection and try again.

toasts.ackError: Couldn't save that — check your connection and try again.
